title: Sweeper Whisper Loop Chaos Construction
author: Christounet
rules:
This is another loop chaos construction puzzle, with sweeper clues. Have fun solving!

The puzzle :

Play on sudokupad.

Play on Penpa.

Rules :

- Chaos construction : Divide the grid into orthogonally connected 9-cell regions such that each cell is part of exactly one region. Fill the grid with digits 1-9 such that no digit repeats in any row, column or region.

- Whisper Loop : Draw a one-cell-wide loop of orthogonally connected cells. The loop may not touch itself, not even diagonally.

The loop visits each region exactly once.

The loop acts as a German Whispers line (i.e., adjacent digits on the loop must have a difference of at least 5).

- Circle clues : Cells with circle clues are on the loop and the digit in the circle indicates the total number of cells (including itself) in the 3x3 area centered on that cell that are part of the same region as that cell.
solutionCode: Column 2, with hyphens (-) for region borders. (Example: 123-45-6-789)
